title: Liberty sign Anneli Maley to full-season contract as injury replacement: 'I've been promoted'
text:
Anneli Maley thought her time with the Liberty was over. Eventually, she listened to the message again and realized it was quite the opposite.
For 10 minutes, she stared at her phone almost in disbelief at the lengthy voice memo she had just received from Liberty general manager Jonathan Kolb.
The only part that stuck was the end, when Kolb mentioned “we’re getting another . ”Satou Sabally officially ruled out for the season with a head injury, the Liberty had an open roster spot and chose to convert Maley’s developmental contract into a full-season deal Sept. 3.
“I didn’t understand at all at first,” Maley said, speaking to reporters for the first time since getting a new deal. “It was like a grieving process, and then I was like, ‘Oh no, wait, I’ve been promoted! ’Maley’s first full-season WNBA contract, signed two days after she turned 28, is a testament to her determination and relentless pursuit of her goal.
Anneli Maley drives on Morgan Maly during the Liberty’s win over the Sky on Aug. 29, 2026 at Barclays Center. Maley played only two years of college basketball. She was never drafted into the WNBA. She got her first taste of the WNBA in 2022 with the Chicago Sky, who brought her back as a temporary hardship player after training camp.
She had been waived or released seven times. Maley made an interesting case for the Liberty’s final roster spot at this year’s training camp. Ultimately, New York went another direction. After a brief stint with the Phoenix Mercury, the Liberty brought Maley back as a developmental player.
She had been working closely with director of basketball strategy Parker Lovett. She put in countless hours behind the scenes training both solo and with the practice squad. The job of a developmental player can often be overlooked and underappreciated.
“She’s one of those people that can keep things light when sometimes things can feel a little bit heavy,” Jones said. “You can’t really talk about how important that is when you’re going through the course of a season. ” Maley has always prided herself on her defense and rebounding. She believes her biggest growth this season has been on the offensive end.
With Maley’s promotion, the Liberty filled their open developmental spot with former Ole Miss wing Madison Scott. Anneli Maley of the New York Liberty dribbles the ball during a game against the Chicago Sky, Saturday, Aug. 29, 2026, at Barclays Center Arena in Brooklyn, New York.
“I don’t have to lie, I can say: ‘You know what, they really pour into you. They take care of you. They value you as a human, and you will get better,’” Maley said. “It’s hard, but it’s rewarding. ”
